title: Lucien Fenlas
type: Player character · scout and expedition companion
dek: A watchful traveler whose practical help and careful persuasion sit beside a private offer of another source of power.

facts.Journey: The search for Vey and Vaa
facts.Choices: Preserves a prisoner; later demonstrates an unnamed benefactor’s gift
facts.Status: At the Dasa refuge; no agreement with his benefactor is shown

sources: Quest RP refreshed source · supplied 23 October 2026 · 3,845 messages across the main channel and two accessible threads; posting chronology and narrated continuations remain distinct
body:
Lucien joins the northern expedition after speaking of trying to make a living as an herbalist. His anxiety, awkward tea-making and vigilance give the journey an ordinary texture before the night turns violent.

The watch that changes the ambush

During his watch he detects a presence beyond the camp and quietly wakes companions. He scouts the darkness, fights and ultimately knocks the last attacker unconscious, preserving the chance to ask questions. He then argues that the tired group must move before more scouts arrive.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

An offer made in the shadows

At the refuge he approaches a Dasa away from the main conversation and offers to explain what his benefactor might provide. He demonstrates becoming unseen in dim light. The listener says the idea must be considered with Vey and Vaa; no pact, recruitment or acceptance is recorded.

The offer remains distinct from Di’Trillio’s public pledge. The scene does not name Lucien’s benefactor or establish that the power is a safe answer to Dasa captivity.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

A difficult company, still traveling together

He makes tea for Saoirse and watches the approaches while others talk. His friction with Alesteir does not prevent cooperation in preserving the final prisoner. Vel’kaen accompanies him on the flank at the refuge. These scenes record working relationships, without supplying their full earlier histories.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4.
